services.title: Auto detailing
services.body: Vehicles are washed and detailed inside and out, not just rinsed.

reviews_h2: What people are saying about the auto detailing

reviews.author: chasity Murphy
reviews.text: They cracked my dashboard. Both the front and back were not vacuumed well. The front isn’t pictured because I took these pics when I got home, so I already stepped in the car. The side mirror was not clean at all, there’s white streaks on it(as pictured). Not pictured is the front windshield which don’t even look like it’s been cleaned as well as the back windshield. When I went I was told I couldn’t get the platinum package. Which wasn’t a problem, but the fact that they broke my dashboard and it’s not even clean irritated me. Normally they do a phenomenal job but this time was a pretty bad experience. Update: I spoke to Brittany and she viewed the cameras and the crack was there before(I never really noticed it because I never inspected it before I guess.) she was very nice and told me to come back so she could see the shape my car is in and redo it!

reviews.author: Vincent Keisler
reviews.text: I wasn't impressed. First, the staff was rude when I arrived. As I pulled up to get the truck washed the lady standing there didn't pay me any mind and then proceeded to yell at me for pulling too far forward... how was I supposed to know? Then another man came up yelling at me and demanded I get out of my truck and he'd take it from there. To make matters worse the exterior wash and interior detail was not very good. A literal mud print on my door, and several missed spots on the outside and inside. It was only $15 (but can go up to $40+ depending on add ons) but I would never return or recommend this place.

reviews.author: Rachael Horton
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my visit today. I am usually satisfied when I come here for a quick wash and vacuum. Today was a different story. I know it isn't a full detail and not hand washed but for $30 I thought they'd spend more time on cleaning my dash, cup holders, etc. And the vacuuming today was less to be desired. I'm not sure if they guys were new or just young and don't care, but I am not happy.

reviews.author: Mallory Vanover
reviews.text: i got a full detail service at magic tunnel after my car was stolen (twice, in 5 days). The exterior of my car was mostly fine, but he interior smelled like someone had been smoking in it for 5 years straight every day with the windows up with possibly crack. When I got it back, I no longer wanted to vomit in my mouth from sitting in my car for 5 minutes. It actually looked like the day I got it in 2018. They’re just the best. Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Natalie Sanders
reviews.text: The service here has gone down tremendously since the change of ownership. I purchased the gold package and could’ve received better results at a fundraiser car wash. My car was poorly vacuumed. My windows are smudged and there’s no sign of armor all. When I went back in to voice my concerns I was overlooked. I will never patronize with them again.

reviews.author: Georgia Hill
reviews.text: Don't take your car there. They messed up my car. Using a cheap hand brush. Brand new car. The guy in charge could careless. He tried to pretend he didn't see the damage. When the works told me they could see it. Which wasn't there, when I brought the car in to be washed. A new car, please go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Blake Huff
reviews.text: Will never go back. This place use to be good. A couple of years ago I stopped going because the lady at the front desk was incredibly rude. I have been back a couple of times over the last few months simply because it was convenient. When you leave your inside looks almost greasy. Any dirt is just covered up with whatever substance they spray and not actually wiped away. They literally use the spray chemical like paint. They spray it on thick and use a rag to spread it around. Today I was in a hurry and after getting home realized how bad it was. Keep in mind I pay for the most expensive wash. Today I asked the difference between the highest and second highest priced wash. I was told they wipe the out side trim down. They wiped the top of my bumper and one side bed cap and left the other side untouched. Did not touch any other black trim and where they did it was spotty. I have the heavy duty floor liners. I do have a dog and always wipe up the hair before going so all they have to do is hit the few pieces of exposed carpet. They didn’t even do that. I don’t believe they vacuumed at all. There was still dirt in the floor board and debris in every crack and crevice. See pictures attached and I recommend the other wash right down the road.

reviews.author: JOHN STIVERS
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! They really do a great job on your car. I had spilled dog food all over the back of my SUV and they took the time to get into every crack and crevice to get it out. My Yukon looks brand new everytime I get it washed here. Staff is fun to talk to and really care about you AND your car. Top Notch service every time. The prices are very reasonable for the job they do.

reviews.author: Jeff Johnson
reviews.text: Love this family owned business. Started going here when I was 16 years old 20 years later and still going. Seen some bad reviews, and don't know why. If you see something you don't like let them know, they want you happy!

reviews.author: Kevin Mclamb
reviews.text: At one time this place was the best !!! But the last three times have not been satisfactory at all. This is today’s experience with a platinum wash. The picture of my hood is where that blew the paint off with the pressure washer trying to remove a bug. The rest is just a poor job!! Gonna find another car wash! Really a shame tho been having cars washed there for years.

reviews.author: Amanda Smith
reviews.text: I would 100% recommend getting your car washed here. For $20 you can get a full wash vacuum for $30 you can get your car fully detailed with armor all. It is about an hour to an hour and a half of your time but totally worth it rather than running through a $15 car Wash and then having to vacuum it yourself. The workers are super nice and it's super easy to follow the instructions. I come at least once a quarter to get my car detailed.

reviews.author: Rachel Radford
reviews.text: The employees inside are friendly, but my car is nowhere near clean ... this is what a little over $30 gets you......you get what you pay for I guess but I won't be going back

reviews.author: JJ Graham
reviews.text: I have been here for over an hour. Since I have been here 2 cars were put in line in front of me. Those cars were supposed to be washes only but they got the full treatment. They are so slow here since the new owners took over a few years ago. I will never come back or refer this place to anyone.

reviews.author: DJ MIke Brock
reviews.text: Magic Tunnel Car Wash is hands down superior to anything in its industry. I've tried others around Johnston County and most times when I do my walk around I have to call their attention to different things they miss. I typically try to go in times when these places aren't busy because I get when you need to be in churn and burn mode which I take into consideration if I do go during that time. Doesn't matter when I come through here, its consistently don't right. Every time. These guys crush it and I make specific trips out here for my car.

reviews.author: john miller
reviews.text: They do a really good job, and they're very quick at a real good price... I will definitely be coming back!!!!!

reviews.author: ROBERT GRAY
reviews.text: took my SUV in for a platinum wash $40.00 my trunk area wasn't vacuumed only one side of my vehicle was wiped down (wax spots covered the driver side after mentioning the deficiencies several times I was over it and left very disappointed

reviews.author: Synora Cummings
reviews.text: I have not been impressed with the service the last couple of times I have been. Today, I dropped $120 between two vehicles for Platinum service. This included a tip that I should not have left. My vehicles are fairly clean and well kept. They did not vacuum well. Vacuuming was not done under the seats nor in the seats. The interior door frames were not wiped down. I had to call a gentleman back over to wipe down Armor All that was running down the side of the console. Glass was streaky and spotty. The windshield on one vehicle still had bug residue caked on. They did leave a polishing rag in the back which was convenient for all the touch ups once I got back to the house. So, thank you for that. I left a kind complaint with the girl at the desk in hopes that she would pass it on to management. Magic Tunnel has given much better service in the past.

reviews.author: Brittany White
reviews.text: I stopped by to have my car washed and vacuumed around 9:09 am Saturday and asked if they could wipe every thing down including the seats and the young man said yes. They didn’t wipe down seats and Miss some spots on vacuuming. I was ok with all that until later that day when it started to rain and I tried to use my windshield wiper that they were gone! Completely ripped off! I work night shift so after I got my car washed I headed home and went to bed. If it had not been for me leaving the house when the rain came, I wouldn’t have known anything! They are closed on Sunday and I have to wait until Monday to speak to someone. Had to buy new wipers .

reviews.author: Mark Wilson
reviews.text: Our family has used Magic Tunnel Smithfield for years and years. In the past the workers were very conscientious and gave attention to every detail. Since the business changed ownership over this past year, the quality of the service has gone way down. They miss the little things inside like cleaning the dash well, the console, radio, windows smeared, etc. these young people working are just not doing a good job. The speed with which it takes to get the car done has gone way down as well. This was once a thriving business but I'm afraid unless they get a handle on this they will lose more business. Please give us back the high quality service we had for so long. Thanks.

reviews.author: Johnnie Williams
reviews.text: I always get the best wash. And it truly is the best. My dad went there when I was younger. And now I go there on a regular basis. From my 96 Honda accord to now my 2018 ford fusion se. They are truly top notch. And 2 years later, they are still the best. I actually got a tour of the facility the other day. Seriously, the brushes they use are very very soft. And therefore, very safe. I met the owner and he is a genuinely great guy. It's too bad I can't give this company 10 stars. They are really just that outstanding.

reviews.author: Eddie Mace
reviews.text: I always take my vehicles to this place for cleaning. But no more today did it for me. What the hell is wrong with you people I was told at 4:03 pm that I couldn't get a vehicle cleaning due to vacuum guy telling me the boss said no more this all after I sat in line and was next to be vacuumed. May you suffer loss of business I will never recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Ashleigh Gibson
reviews.text: I agree 100% with many of the reviews in regards to the decline in service with new ownership. This has been my go-to for car washes for about 5 years. Since the shift in ownership, they are absolutely missing the details that separate them from others. For example, cup holders are left dirty, wax and soap are left to dry on windows, consoles and dash boards are still dusty, etc. I hope it gets fixed, so I don't have to look elsewhere. I don't have much faith as I'm going on my fourth visit where it's been like this.

reviews.author: Castor Jones
reviews.text: Been a few times lately and have been very happy each time. I always do the platinum wash. Today I left my phone on the bench outside the employees picked it up and turned it in. After calling it a few times they answered it and told me they had it. Never would have guessed I left it there! Remember to tip well! Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Nancy Heflin
reviews.text: A horrible experience. After my truck went through the car wash, they drove it out and forgot about it, letting it air dry leaving water spots all over the vehicle. When I brought it to their attention, one of the guys then took a dry towel and wiped it on certain parts of the truck. The windows were then sprayed and half cleaned, leaving streak marks and spots. They neglected to clean my mirrors. They sprayed all four tires and rims, and only wiped down two of them, leaving the other two with dried up spots. I will never go back!

reviews.author: David Barbour
reviews.text: They do an amazing job of cleaning cars. They clean door jambs, windows, tires, trim and they wipe the car dry. I would give five stars but every time an employee rides in my car through the wash they adjust everything! The seat is way out of whack, radio is changed, even the steering wheel sometimes. You don't have to turn, the tire is in a track. Can you please just ride the length of the building without customizing my controls? It takes me a while to get it straight so I can leave the parking lot. I'm 5'8", pretty average and dont have the seat pulled up tight to the wheel, so I don't get it. But anyway, it's not a deal breaker, just a bit aggravating, and they do great work and do it quick to.

reviews.author: Brittany Berrier
reviews.text: If you want your car to look better than it did the day you drove it off the lot, go to Magic Tunnel. I regret when I don’t get a chance to get my car washed here. They do such an awesome job detailing my car. The employees are friendly and hard working!

reviews.author: Stacey Griffith
reviews.text: They broke our windshield there April 05, 2023. The cameras did show no damage to our vehicle before it went through the car wash. Gary Lee the owner admitted fault and said they would take care of it. Now the other owner is lying about everything and is refusing to pay. Beware these people are liars. We’ve been going for a couple years but never again.

reviews.author: Diana P
reviews.text: Good service. They just need more drying cloths or ones that have more surface area. Windshield and other areas had streaks because cloth probably too damp for drying. Other than that great service.

reviews.author: Pagan Chavez
reviews.text: They always leave my cars squeaky clean. Oh and trust me. First time I took my car that has never been cleaned they left it spotless. I thought I was gonna have to take it back ok a few days just to get it spotless. But no. They did it all in one day! I love this place.

reviews.author: Gabe Clark
reviews.text: Magic Tunnel did an excellent job on our vehicle. Fast, courteous, & at an excellent price. I would highly recommend to anyone needing their car washed in the Smithfield & surrounding areas.

reviews.author: Michael Quarles
reviews.text: Gone down hill, cashier looks like she is trying to sleep, way too much talking and playing and not enough cleaning. Last 2 visits people that were not working (friends) distracting the people working. A good job was done but took way too long. Service has gone way down and prices up. No supervision. Learned today that ownership has changed. That explains it!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Solaro
reviews.text: First time there today and they did a great job. Had a bunch of salt/snow from my trip up north and it looks like new again Great service, competitive pricing, and in/out in less than 30 minutes despite having several folks in front of me.

reviews.author: thomas jopek
reviews.text: I have been going to the Tunnel Car wash for years and I wouldn’t go anywhere else because they are the best car wash in the area . No need for you to go to a detailing shop because they do everything and their prices are affordable. They have two employees vacuum and clean your floor mats, one employee pressure wash’s it before it goes through the actual car wash and after it comes out they have a team of detailing experts wiping your entire car off including windows inside and out and applying any detailing products that you have purchased with the cashier .

reviews.author: Sandra Baker
reviews.text: I took my car and had it cleaned inside and out... The waxing was good but as for tge interior it was horrible.. It looked like they sprayed armorall everywhere and did not wipe I had grass all over my back seat and what they cleaned the windows smudge so I couldn't see at night... The trunk track wasnt cleaned and I called back and the man I spole to was so rude. The problem was not fixed I did it myself. Also the stuff on my mirror was torn after they finished

reviews.author: Janah Thornton
reviews.text: Disappointed! I just referred someone to this place and shouldn't have. I have done the "full service" and tire shine on my car 5 different times now. Last time I wasn't pleased with how dirty they left the floor and seat in my backseat. I expressed this with the lady today and she said she'd make sure they got it all today. So I expected today to go better. When i gor my car, there are water places left in my center console area, water on my mats, dirt left in the back seat that I could pick up with my hand so clearly the vacuum should have, fingerprints on the handles and window...I am disappointed. My car is new and it's been cleaned out and vacuumed out every week since purchased and it's not even 2 months old! I will not go back.

reviews.author: Ifranco25 _
reviews.text: Always come here for a car wash for all my vehicles. Never disappoints. Very clean and great on pricing! They continue doing great here, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: J Up
reviews.text: They put a crack in my neighbors windshield, told them they would replace it after reciewing the video and seeing they were at fault. Then gave the run around and now refuses to pay. Worthless owners if that is the case. Save your money and goto a more reputable business that stands by their service, and quality. Zero stars if that was an option.

reviews.author: Belinda Campbell
reviews.text: Somehow my leather back seat got cut and when I reported it to the manager he came up with every excuse not to reimburse me for their negligence. Plus. I spend $30 each time I go there and they never clean my windows properly. Some of those guys has no experience at all.

reviews.author: jill mutone
reviews.text: Horrible, they broke a piece off my car. When I called I was hung up on PURPOSELY!!! When back on phone his excuse was he had customers. ( The person I spoke to was the owners son)... Also, noticed employee's smoking around cars while doors were open...... First and last ever there. I would say 0 stars but was not an option!!

reviews.author: Gustavo Gonzalez
reviews.text: Best price in town & they do a great job! However, they need to change their hours of operations from 8-5 to 8-4:30. The office may be open until 5:00, but I drove into their lot at 4:30 and they turned me away.

reviews.author: charles deziel
reviews.text: I have brought my car here 3 times to get the inside and outside of my car cleaned and each time these men have done a wonderful job! Always so clean after and they never miss a spot!

reviews.author: Paul N
reviews.text: Paid for the "Top of LIne" car wash at the Prince Frederick MD location, but was very surprised when I had to vacuum the interior myself. No one hand dried my car, no one cleaned my interior windows, no one hand cleaned my wheels, no one applied tire shine and no one wiped my dash / interior. I brought my attention to the on duty manager, but got nothing. Do no use this car wash unless you want to be ripped off.

reviews.author: Ronika Bompus
reviews.text: We needed a quick wash to get the salt off the car. We stopped here and for 8 bucks got a sparkly clean car. It even includes an air freshener, which I love the smell.

reviews.author: Angel Marie
reviews.text: Never had a bad experience. My car had cat hair and Christmas tree needles all over. Plus I have a 2 year old. Now she looks good as new.

reviews.author: David Exum
reviews.text: I drove from Clayton to try this place out. Excellent service and a great car wash! The lads even washed me windows and toweled the car off. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Pamela Lewis
reviews.text: So sad about my $30 detail! Inside of my windshield was only cleaned where you look straight out. My dash was only partially wiped with Armour All. I used to look forward to getting my car cleaned here but my last 3 trips have been disappointing.

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.text: Been going here for years always great service until today, my car wasn’t properly washed the tires either. Never thought I would experience this.

reviews.author: Wanda Ryals-Mitchell
reviews.text: Always a very pleasant place to get the car cleaned. They are very friendly, paying attention to detail, and go above and beyond to keep your service coming to them.

reviews.author: Tamara Slaughter
reviews.text: Magic tunnel is awesome. They treat their customers well. My husband and I take our cars all the time I would recommend them to everyone

reviews.author: Derek Frye
reviews.text: Hands Down, The Best Drive Thru Car Wash I’ve Have Ever Experienced!!!!!! Staff, Price, And OMG Results!!!!!! I Am From Knightdale And Just Happened To Be In The Area And Let Me Tell You, I WISH THEY WERE CLOSER!!!!!! Detail Experience From A Car Wash, Who Would Have Thought!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Phyllis Coats
reviews.text: Sometimes they do a fair detail. Sometimes windshield is streaky and I hate that. But I do prefer them to any other car wash.

reviews.author: gregory galloway
reviews.text: This service was quick the employees were very polite. The team that wiped the car down could have paid a little bit more attention to detail.

reviews.author: Sandy Gibbs
reviews.text: Shoutout to RUSSELL - He graciously helped to remove a large chunk of tree sap off the windshield after the other guy told me my car was ready.

reviews.author: Crystal Huskey
reviews.text: Purchased the Platinum and went back and had it waxed. Looks like it just came off the car lot! Looks amazing! Thanks Magic Tunnel!

reviews.author: Darryl Galloway
reviews.text: Not thrilled at all. Had to send my truck back twice in one day. Vacuuming was bad and the tires was done by someone with a back ache

reviews.author: Jacob eason
reviews.text: This is by far the shittiest car wash I've ever been to as far as service. I've taken 3 if my trucks up there and every time they have an excuse for why they can't run my truck threw the wash. Vehicle is "too dirty". "Will get my brushes dirty" SMH

reviews.author: Sarah Harrison
reviews.text: I was very satisfied with my experience. Not only did they do a great job cleaning they were also very polite and accommodating.

reviews.author: Sherrie Joyner
reviews.text: I had an amputation on my foot and I'm not able to walk well. Chris was AWESOME! He helped me in & out of my car and its soooooo clean I almost didnt recognize it.

reviews.author: Selena Duran
reviews.text: Would never take my car anywhere else after coming here they did a amazing job they are well priced and friendly unlike Sun Auto!

reviews.author: Melissa Overton
reviews.text: My family has been going to the magic tunnel car Wash for at least 30 years! Always top notch. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: David Adams
reviews.text: They did a really good job. There were a few little thing I could have nit picked about. But over all a good job, the truck looked good.

reviews.author: Vicky McAbee
reviews.text: Awesome best car wash in NC I come from Charlotte several times a year and always have them detail my car.

reviews.author: Reesycup
reviews.text: I heard so many bad review....the good news is that ...I will not go to get my vehicles washed there..."nope smh noway'!!

reviews.author: Caroline Parker
reviews.text: Great job!!! Always enjoy talking with the owner during my visits. This family knows how to work!!! Appreciate their quick and thorough service!

reviews.author: Jim Jenkins
reviews.text: Randy and Eddie make sure the guys who work there do a good job! I have been going there for over 20 years.

reviews.author: Old School and His BEATS
reviews.text: Excellent staff and ownership. Not only will you get a clean ride but you will also get a laugh or two.

reviews.author: Shawn Alexander
reviews.text: The Best in the business for our area... Attention to detail is spot on! or should I say Spot off? :)

reviews.author: Randy Becker
reviews.text: Being from Michigan you just don't see this kind of service any more. To bad every business isn't run this way.

reviews.author: Heather Alley
reviews.text: I spent $38.95 for a car wash plus tax & they did a horrible job! I asked them to run it through the automatic car wash again and both times it came out bone dry! I watched them spray water on the car with a power wash gun before it went into the car wash and water was spraying out at the tire level going into the wash but no water was being sprayed from the top of the car wash so my car came out with pollen still on it which I was able to wipe off very easily when I got home with a damp diaper wipe. I won’t be going back. I had liked their service for years and was a regular customer but they raised their prices & the quality of the cleaning service went way down. I’m not sure if the car wash was broken that day but if it was then they should not have charged me almost $40.!!! I asked for a refund & told them I was not happy with the service after both cleanings and pointed out the pollen but they said no refunds.

reviews.author: Lari Ham
reviews.text: The service here is horrible now-a-days. They never vaccuum my trunk or clean the inside of my doors. Sad how it’s gone downhill
